$comment: Lighthouse CI for the Fila, signed in (ADR-0010 § 1, T116), on the mobile preset: the e-mail deep link /fila/{id} opens on a phone. scripts/lighthouse-local.sh runs it with the seeded case's URL. scripts/lighthouse-panel-login.cjs logs in through the local mock API before each run; Lighthouse's storage reset clears the HTTP cache before every run but keeps cookies (Lighthouse 12's default clearStorageTypes), so every run is a cold load, signed in. puppeteerLaunchOptions.args replaces chromeFlags, which LHCI ignores with a puppeteerScript. Median of 3. LCP per ADR-0007: warn above 2500 ms, fail above 3000 ms (one assertion per audit key, hence the two assertMatrix entries, as in lighthouserc.json); CLS <= 0.1; category scores from frontend-qa-conventions.md § Accessibility & Performance Gates. Thresholds are the Frontend Architect's: change them only through the plan or an ADR.
